paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat bel hong hau in athupi mahmah a, huchi in Ahab toh kizopna abawl hi.
heading: Zawlnei Mikaiah In Ahab Avauhilhna / (1 Kum 22.1-28)
english: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab.

paite: Kum bangzah hiam nung in Samaria ah Ahab kiang ah ahohsuk a, Ahab in amah leh aheute belam leh bawngtalte tampi ana goh a, Ramoth-gilead a hohtouhpih ding in achial hi.
english: After some years, he went down to Ahab to Samaria. Ahab killed sheep and cattle for him in abundance, and for the people who were with him, and moved him to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead ah i hohtoukhawm kei dia hia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, gal i doukhawm ding uh," achi hi.
english: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”

paite: Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA thu hungaih phot lai in," achi hi.
english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n, zawlneite mi zali asamkhawm a, akiang uah, "Ramoth-gilead khua sual ding in ka kuan ding uam, kuan lou ding?" achi hi. Amau, "Kuan in, Pathian in kumpipa khut ah ape ding," achi uhi.
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, “Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They said, “Go up, for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "TOUPA zawlnei kuate hiam i dot ding a-om kei ua eita aw?" achi hi.
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh besides, that we may inquire of him?”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "TOUPA hon dotsak ding mi khat a-om; himahleh amah bel ka muhdah lamtak ahi; ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam kia lou ngal ahoih lam himhim agen ngei kei a; huai mi bel Imla tapa Mikaiah ahi," achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n heutu khat asam a, "Imla tapa Mikaiah hon pi meng dih," achi hi.
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”

paite: Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Samaria kulh kongpi lutna chin mun awng ah akumpi puan ua kizem in alaltutphah tuaktuak uah atu ua; zawlnei tengteng in ama uah thu agen uhi.
english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

paite: Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sik kiite abawl a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiaite in Siriate mangthang sipsip khop in na sual ding achi," achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

paite: Huchi mah bang in zawlnei dangte'n leng, "Ramoth-gilead ah hoh inla, lamzang in; TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ape ding hi," chi in agen uhi.
english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Mikaiah sam dia asawlpa un, "Ngai dih, zawlneite'n kithutuaktak in ahoih lam in kumpipa kiang ah thu agen chiat ua; huaiziak in nang leng achihsa bang un ahoih lam in va gen sam dih ve," chi in agen hi.
english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”

paite: Huan Mikaiah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka chi hi, ka Pathian in achih bang geih in ahi ka gen ding," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, I will say what my God says.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa kiang atun in kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead khua sual ding in ka kuan ding uam, kuan lou ding?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Kuan unla, va lamzang un, na khut a piak ahi ding hi," achi hi.
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Thutak keleu lou ka kiang ah TOUPA min a gen lou ding in bangzah vei ahia nang ka hon kichiamsak ding?" achi hi.
english: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”

paite: Ama'n, "Belamchingtu nei lou bang in Israel tengteng tang ah dalhzak in ka mu a; TOUPA'N, hiaite'n heutu anei kei ua, amau inn lam ah lungmuangtak in pai diam uhen achi," achi hi.
english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka tungtang thu zaw aselam kia lou ngal ahoih lam himhim ahihleh agen sam kei ding chih ka hon hilh ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

paite: Mikaiah in agen nawn a, "TOUPA thu ngaikhia un, TOUPA alaltutphah a tu, van mipite tengteng ataklam leh aveilam a dingh ka mu hi.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word: I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

paite: TOUPA'N Ramoth-gilead a Israel kumpipa Ahab kuantou a, va si ding a kua'n ahia khem ding? achih chiang in khat in, 'Huchi khachi in' achi a, midang in, 'Huchibang khachibang in' achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.

paite: Kha khat ahong pawt a, TOUPA ma a dingh in, 'Ke'n ka khem ding,' achi hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, 'Bang in eita?' achi hi.
english: A spirit came out, stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ “Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’

paite: Ama'n, 'Ka va hoh ding a, zawlneite tengteng kam ah kha zuauthei in ka va suak ding,' achi hi. Huan ama'n, 'Na va khem ngei ding a, na lohching ding, kuan inla, huchibang in hih in,' " achi hi.
english: “He said, ‘I will go, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ “He said, ‘You will entice him, and will prevail also. Go and do so.’

paite: Huchi in ngai dih, TOUPA'N, "Hiai zawlneite kam ah kha zuauthei akoih a; na tungthu TOUPA'N ahoih lou lam in agenta ahi," achi hi.
english: “Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

paite: Huaitak in Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in ava naih a, Mikaiah biang ah abeng a, "Na kiang a thugen ding TOUPA kha in koilam a hon pawtsan ahia?" achi hi.
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

paite: Mikaiah in, "Ngai dih, dantan sunggil a bu ding a na lut ni chiang in na hon thei ding," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n, "Mikaiah pi unla, kho ukpa Ammon leh kumpipa tapa kiang ah paipih nawn un.
english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

paite: Kumpipa'n hichi in achi a, 'Hiai mi suangkul ah khum unla, lungmuangtak a ka hong pai nawn masiah gimthuakna an leh gimthuakna tui pia un,' achi a, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
english: and say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.”’”

paite: Huan Mikaiah in, "Lungmuang- tak a na hong pai nawn peuhmahleh TOUPA'N kei hon zang a thu gen lou ahi ding hi," achi a, amah mah in, "Nou mipi tengteng in leng na za un," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, you people, all of you!”

paite: Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ava hohtou uhi.
heading: Ahab Sihna / (1 Kum 22.29-35)
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Kei ka kibawl lamdang ding a, kisualna ah ka hoh sam ding; nang zaw na kumpipa puan kisilh in," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa bel akibawl lamdang a, kidouna ah ahohtou hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went into the battle.

paite: Siria kumpipa'n akangtalaite tung a heutute kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa lou ngal mineu leng milian leng na sual ding uh ahi kei," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, "Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Jehoshaphat amuh uleh Israel kumpipa ahi ve," achi ua. Huchi in sual tum in a-umta uhi; himahleh Jehoshaphat akikou a, TOUPA'N apanpihta a, huchi in Pathian in amau amah anusesak hi.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and Yahweh helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, kangtalai tung a heutute'n Israel kumpipa ahi kei chih atheih un delh nawn lou in akiksanta uhi.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

paite: Mi khat in ngim tuam nei lou in athalpeu alai a, Israel kumpipa a-awmphaw leh a-awmphaw kikal ah akha a, huchi in akangtalai hawlpa kiang ah, "Lehhawl inla, mipi lak a kipan hon paikhiakpih in, liamna natak ka tuak hi," achi hi.
english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of the chariot, “Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

paite: Huai ni in kisualna athupi mahmah a; Israel kumpipa bel Siriate lam nga in akangtalai ah nitaklam tanpha in adingh a; huan nitum kuan in asita hi.
english: The battle increased that day. However, the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the evening; and at about sunset, he died.
